::: {.callout-note title="How It Works" collapse="true"} Retrieve information from preregistrations in a standardised way, and make them easier to check. The Preregistration Check module identifies preregistrations on the OSF and AsPredicted based on links in the manuscript, retrieves the preregistration text, and organizes the information into a template. The module retrieves text from the OSF with its API, and from AsPredicted with ResearchBox's API when a ResearchBox key is set (see `rbox_token()`), or else from the preregistration's web page. The information in the preregistration is returned. An AsPredicted link that could not be read is named in the report, with the reason. The module can’t extract information from non-structured preregistration templates (i.e., where the preregistration is uploaded in a single text field) and it can’t retrieve information in preregistrations that are stored as text documents on the OSF. If you want to extend the package to be able to download information from other preregistration sites, reach out to the Metacheck development team. This module was developed by Daniel Lakens and Lisa DeBruine Read more in the [metacheck manual](https://www.scienceverse.org/metacheck_book/chapters/mod-prereg-check.html). :::
